about_the_game:
DRAGON TALE is a student made Adventure Fantasy RPG inspired by your favorite classics. Play as a city guard tasked to investigate the recent increase in monsters nearby. Along your journey, fight against ferocious creatures, put your problem solving skills to the test and uncover the various hidden treasures throughout the world.

MAKE USE OF YOUR WEAPONS

During your adventure, find and acquire unique weapons that will help you traverse and fight throughout the land. Use everything at your disposal to vanquish your foes and conquer any hurdles that may come your way.

INTERACT WITH THE TOWN

The City of Fariah is home to many denizens which you can interact and exchange with. Whether it's small talk, a personal request or a business transaction, you can hear them out at anytime.

EXPLORE A UNIQUE WORLD

Make your way through a beautifully handcrafted world made with care. Discover new areas, each with unique challenges and secrets to unfold.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3570 or AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 4GB / AMD Radeon RX 470 4GB
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 6GB / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 590 8GB / AMD Radeon RX 6500XT 4GB
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Enter DRAGON TALE, a student made Adventure Fantasy RPG where you explore a unique island and battle against grueling monsters. Interact with the townsfolk, loot exciting treasures and discover powerful weapons to help you banish the lurking evil.
